text: Quang Ninh welcomes five millionth international visitor in 2026
Northern Quang Ninh city welcomed its five millionth international visitor of 2026 on November 14, marking a milestone for the city's tourism sector.
The visitor arrived in Ha Long aboard the luxury cruise ship Celebrity Millennium, which departed from Hong Kong.
The milestone comes as Quang Ninh's international cruise tourism continues to grow.
In the first 10 months of 2026, the city received 52 international cruise ship calls, bringing nearly 62,000 visitors to explore local attractions and experiences, up 9% from the same period in 2025.
The city is expected to welcome around 20 more cruise ships carrying approximately 30,000 international passengers in the final two months of the year.

Among the scheduled arrivals are several large vessels, including Adora Flora City, carrying 5,200 passengers; Celebrity Solstice, with 2,800; Diamond Princess, with 2,700; and Norwegian Jade, with 2,300.
Alongside visits to heritage sites and cultural landmarks, rural tourism experiences are also becoming an important part of Quang Ninh's tourism offering.
These activities give visitors opportunities to discover local lifestyles and communities, adding a more authentic dimension to their journeys.
